name: Okapi Wildlife Reserve
description: This reserve protects roughly 14,000 square kilometres of the Ituri rainforest in north-eastern Congo, about a fifth of the whole forest. It is a stronghold of the shy, zebra-striped okapi, with around 5,000 living here, alongside threatened primates and birds. Waterfalls tumble along the Ituri and Epulu rivers, and Mbuti and Efe hunters still live in the forest. Armed groups now endanger it.
